planets.name: TOI-564 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-564 with a 1.65-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-564 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-564. Its orbit and size follow Davis et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
